meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 该技能会在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个带螺栓图标的持久状态指示器,通过绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 正在运行还是已停止。用户可通过点击图标来启动、停止或重启服务,并可直接查看日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器(或运行 /add-macos-statusbar)时触发;仅在 macOS 上执行,非 macOS 会停止并提示。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器。
检查 NanoClaw 是否已经有菜单栏状态图标。

say.note: 若此前安装失败或需要更新,可重跑该技能。

howto.what_en: This skill adds a persistent bolt-icon status indicator to the macOS menu bar, showing whether NanoClaw is running (green dot) or stopped (red dot). Users can click the icon to start, stop, or restart the service, and view logs directly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw (or runs /add-macos-statusbar). Works only on macOS; on other platforms it stops and informs the user.
